entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm trying to return something, and I'm just so lost. The website is really confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item you'd like to return?
It's this new Aero Race jersey I bought. I tried it on, but it's the wrong size. It feels way too tight across the chest.
Okay, so it sounds like a preference issue with the fit, not a technical fault with the jersey itself, is that correct?
Yes, that's right. I think I just need to exchange it for the next size up. I was trying to do it online, but I couldn't figure it out. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I'd be happy to walk you through it. Let me just pull up your account. I see the order here. The jersey was delivered 27 days ago.
Oh, is that a problem? I wasn't sure what the rules were.
Not a problem at all. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

You're very welcome. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print that out, attach it to the package, and you can drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue your refund.
That's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
